summary: ZenaTech, Inc., a Nasdaq-listed Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a routine Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, solely to report its issued and outstanding share count: 201,157,883 common shares as of September 30, 2026. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is incorporated by reference into the company's existing Form F-3 shelf registration (File No. 333-293356). This is an ordinary administrative disclosure updating share capital, not a special situation; no deal terms, mechanics, or risk-arb angle apply.
